parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const input=$input.first().json;const headers=input.headers||{};const body=JSON.stringify(input.body||{});const secret=$env.INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET;if(!secret||secret.length<32)throw new Error('Internal signing secret is unavailable');const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${headers['x-internal-timestamp']}.${headers['x-internal-nonce']}.${body}`).digest('hex');if(!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected),Buffer.from(headers['x-internal-signature']||'')))throw new Error('Invalid dispatch signature');const [payload,signature]=(input.body.executionToken||'').split('.');const tokenExpected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(payload||'').digest('hex');if(!signature||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(tokenExpected),Buffer.from(signature)))throw new Error('Invalid execution token');const claims=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload,'base64url').toString());if(claims.exp<=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000))throw new Error('Expired execution token');if(claims.executionId!==input.body.executionId||claims.organizationId!==input.body.organizationId)throw new Error('Execution token scope mismatch');return [{json:{...input.body,claims}}];

const crypto=require('crypto');const value=$input.first().json;const body=JSON.stringify({executionId:value.executionId,executionStatus:'RUNNING',message:'n8n accepted the authorized execution'});const timestamp=String(Math.floor(Date.now()/1000));const nonce=crypto.randomUUID();const signature=crypto.createHmac('sha256',$env.INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET).update(`${timestamp}.${nonce}.${body}`).digest('hex');return [{json:{...value,callbackBody:body,callbackTimestamp:timestamp,callbackNonce:nonce,callbackSignature:signature}}];
